scale_note: every file is 6x of app size (px_6x) except panel_spill.png (1x); size_1x unchanged
format: sRGB 8-bit RGBA PNG, PREMULTIPLIED alpha; additive layers have alpha 0 (egui: a premultiplied Color32 with a = 0 adds); 6x app size unless noted (scale by pixels_per_point / 6)

geometry.note: app px at 1x, measured in tiles/ref/10_player.png (1440 x 900)

thumb.view: face-on (straight down), the same camera as the gem and the stones

thumb.blend: t = ln(d/a) / ln(b/a) between the nodes around d (clamp d to 139..587); draw delta_a with grey((1-t) * (glow I(d)/I(a))^p) and delta_b with grey(t * (glow I(d)/I(b))^p)
thumb.d: |gem centre - thumb centre| (thumb centre on the bar centre line)

tints_srgb.note: already baked into every delta / layer; only needed if the app re-bakes

switch.to_paused: lit 1 -> 0 over 0.35 s smoothstep, sign stays PAUSE; at lit = 0 swap the sign to PLAY
switch.to_playing: swap the sign to PAUSE at once, then lit 0 -> 1 over 0.30 s smoothstep
switch.gem_sprite: blend gem_dark_<sign> and gem_lit_<sign> by lit (never two signs at once)

states.pressed: content 1 px down, x0.94, tighter shadow (baked); gem_glow weight 0

constants.icon: the keys' << >>: ink (44,46,50), 2 px round-capped strokes, chevron tips at x = -4.4 and +1.6 px from the stone centre (back points left), arms 4.6 px long, +-5.2 px tall; a light lip (255,255,255,120) 0.9 px lower drawn first

track_left.png.anchor_is: the slot start (bar start); y = the bar centre line
track_left.png.how: slot start (x = 0) at 6 px from the piece's left edge

track_tile.png.anchor_is: tile origin: bar start + 64k; y = the bar centre line
track_tile.png.how: repeat every 64 px from bar start + 64

track_right.png.anchor_is: the slot end; y = the bar centre line
track_right.png.how: slot end at 60 px from the piece's left edge: place it at bar end - 60

fill_left.png.anchor_is: the slot start; y = the bar centre line
fill_left.png.how: slot start at 6 px; the fill's round start begins 1.75 px in

fill_light_left.png.blend: normal (premultiplied (c, a)); out = fb(1 - w a) + w c
fill_light_left.png.anchor_is: the slot start (same rect as fill_left)
fill_light_left.png.weight: per column w(x) = clamp((glow * I(d(x)) / I(150))^0.8, 0, 1), d(x) = |gem centre - (slot_start + x, bar centre)|; vertex colours of the strip's quads
fill_light_left.png.how: draw right after the matching fill piece, same rects

fill_tile.png.how: 64 px period, phase 0 at the bar start: tile k covers bar_start + 64k .. +64
